body.purpose: Homepage body text and shared copy.

components.name: Primary link
components.description: A navigational anchor for the main reading action, with an immediate hover state and keyboard outline.
components.html: Explore the game design ↗
components.css: .ds-primary-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; color: var(--paper, #f9f9f6); background: var(--accent, #304f3d); padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 3px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; font-family: var(--body, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-primary-link:hover { background: #213d2c; color: white; } .ds-primary-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #304f3d); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: The two header links retain plain text styling, with an underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-header-nav { display: flex; gap: 29px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; font-family: var(--body, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-header-nav a { color: var(--ink, #262c28); text-decoration: none; padding-block: 12px; text-underline-offset: .22em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-header-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent, #304f3d); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-header-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #304f3d); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-header-nav { font-size: 12px; gap: 18px; } }

components.name: Documentation navigation
components.description: A vertical link list with an explicit current page; it wraps horizontally on smaller screens.
components.html: OverviewThe gameCompetitionAgents & engineResearch foundations
components.css: .ds-doc-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; line-height: 1.65; font-family: var(--body, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-doc-nav a { font-size: 14px; padding: 7px 0; text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted, #616a63); text-underline-offset: .22em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-doc-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--ink, #262c28); } .ds-doc-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--ink, #262c28); font-weight: 600; } .ds-doc-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #304f3d); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (max-width: 800px) { .ds-doc-nav { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px 22px; } .ds-doc-nav a { font-size: 13px; } }

components.name: Cell diagram
components.description: Eight static cells use values, A/B labels, a dashed border, and a cross to explain policy and controller state.
components.css: .ds-cell-figure { margin: 30px 0; color: var(--ink, #262c28); font-family: var(--body, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-cell-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; max-width: 620px; } .ds-cell { border: 1px solid #849981; background: #e2e9dc; width: 64px; aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-size: 20px; position: relative; border-radius: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-cell-second { background: #f1e9dc; border-color: #b6a184; } .ds-cell-policy { position: absolute; bottom: 2px; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1; } .ds-cell-wounded { background: var(--paper, #f9f9f6); border-style: dashed; border-color: #7a6255; } .ds-wound-mark { position: absolute; top: -9px; right: -5px; background: var(--paper, #f9f9f6); color: #765445; width: 16px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; text-align: center; } .ds-cell-figure figcaption { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-cell-figure figcaption > span { color: var(--muted, #616a63); font-size: 12px; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-cell-row { gap: 6px; } .ds-cell { width: calc((100% - 42px) / 8); font-size: 16px; border-radius: 5px; } .ds-wound-mark { font-size: 14px; width: 13px; top: -7px; } }

components.name: Illustrative conversation
components.description: Labeled turns separated by rules, reproducing the homepage conversation without interactive chat controls.
components.html:
You

Keep the quick one. Breed for recovery. I want to know what changes.

Agent

The offspring spends longer on healthy arrays, but gets around the stalled cell. I can disable its detour rule and compare both versions.

You

Do that. Then try a world it hasn’t seen.

An example of intended play. The Rust engine and agent skills are still to be built.
components.css: .ds-conversation { margin-top: 28px; max-width: 730px; color: var(--ink, #262c28); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65; font-family: var(--body, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-message { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr; gap: 20px; padding-block: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d9ddd5); } .ds-message:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9ddd5); } .ds-speaker { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding-top: 3px; } .ds-message p { margin: 0; max-width: 60ch; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-figure-note { margin: 14px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #616a63); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; font-family: var(--body, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-message { grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; gap: 12px; } .ds-message p { font-size: 15px; } }

components.name: Documentation code block
components.description: Monospace proposal commands on the wash surface, with local horizontal scrolling. The example is not an installable CLI.
components.css: .ds-code-block { color: var(--ink, #262c28); background: var(--wash, #edf0e9); padding: 22px; border-radius: 3px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-code-block code { padding: 0; background: transparent; font-size: inherit; font-family: inherit; white-space: pre; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-code-block { padding: 16px; } }

narrative.overview:
The website uses an off-white page, dark text, serif headings, and restrained green links. Hierarchy comes from type size, reading width, whitespace, and fine dividers. The user requested minimal styling; this record describes the resulting implementation rather than a new visual direction.

The layout stays flat. Small labeled diagrams explain the game concept, and documentation uses the same type and palette as the homepage. There are no decorative animations, gradients, or shadows in the current implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white background with dark text and muted supporting copy.
Newsreader headings paired with Arial body text.
Flat sections separated by thin rules and generous spacing.
Diagrams use labels and marks alongside color.
Immediate hover and focus feedback, with no animated transitions.
dos: Do preserve the off-white page, dark text, green accent, and fine dividers.
Do use Newsreader regular for large headings and Arial for body text and navigation.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and the skip link.
Do label diagram categories and disabled controllers with text or marks as well as color.
Do keep wide code and tables scrollable within the reading column.
Do identify concept illustrations and illustrative conversation as proposals.
donts: Don't add decorative motion, shadows, or gradients when extending this minimally styled surface.
Don't substitute interactive game controls for the current static illustrations.
Don't rely on color alone to convey policy or controller state.
Don't describe this captured website system as an implemented game interface.
